text:
Conflict card for developer:

Input case is a pallet with fragile = true and automated_aisle = true.

Rule A - Fragile pallets require manual picking - triggers action manual_pick.

Rule B - An automated aisle requires robot picking - triggers action robot_pick.

manual_pick and robot_pick are incompatible and cannot both be done.

Which rule wins for this input?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
